na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_potential_fi.name: Na2SiO3 Potential File for Quenching - Level 1
na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_potential_fi.description: Procure the appropriate BKS type potential file for sodium silicate for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.name: Na2SiO3 NPT Quenching - Level 1
na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Na2SiO3 molten structure and BKS type potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform NPT quenching simulation of Na2SiO3 using LAMMPS. Cool the system from 4000 K down to 300 K with a cooling rate of 10 K/ps under NPT ensemble at zero external pressure with pressure damping factor of 10000. The potential file already contains the required pair_style, pair_coeff, and kspace_style commands and should be included directly. As a final output, return the absolute paths to the simulation log file and the restart file of the final glassy configuration.

na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_equilibratio.name: Na2SiO3 Glass Equilibration - Level 1
na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_equilibratio.description: Given paths to LAMMPs restart file for glassy Na2SiO3 at 300K and BKS type potential file, equilibrate the glassy Na2SiO3 under NPT ensemble at 300K for 100 ps at zero external pressure with pressure damping factor 5000. The potential file already contains the required pair_style, pair_coeff, and kspace_style commands and should be included directly. As a final output, return the absolute path to the simulation log file.

na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculati.name: Na2SiO3 Tg Calculation - Level 1
na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculati.description: Given the LAMMPS log file from the quenching simulation of Na2SiO3, extract the density and temperature data and estimate the glass transition temperature (Tg) from the change in slope of the density–temperature curve. Return Tg in units of K.
